participant_id.Description: BIDS participant identifier corresponding to the participant's sub-* directory.

age.Description: Participant age at the time of the MRI scan.

included_in_analysis.Description: Whether the participant was included in the analyses reported in the associated publication.

exclusion_reason.Description: Reason the participant was excluded from the reported analyses; n/a indicates that the participant was included.

Levels.n/a: Participant included in the reported analyses
Levels.excessive_motion: Excluded because of excessive head motion
Levels.task_performance_outlier: Excluded because task performance was an extreme outlier
Levels.did_not_follow_instructions: Excluded because the participant did not follow task instructions

main_runs.Description: Number of main experimental-task fMRI runs acquired for the participant.

sipsts_runs.Description: Number of social-interaction (SI-pSTS) localizer fMRI runs acquired for the participant.

tom_runs.Description: Number of theory-of-mind localizer fMRI runs acquired for the participant.

physics_runs.Description: Number of physics localizer fMRI runs acquired for the participant.
